html:
SPRING

Tiles 레이아웃 · Spring

요약: pom 라이브러리, tiles-def.xml definition · {1}, ViewResolver order, insertAttribute

1. pom.xml — 라이브러리 5개

xml
<properties>
  <org.apache.tiles-version>3.0.8</org.apache.tiles-version>
</properties>
<!-- tiles-jsp, tiles-core, tiles-servlet, tiles-api, tiles-template (mvnrepository.com 검색) -->
<dependency>
  <groupId>org.apache.tiles</groupId>
  <artifactId>tiles-jsp</artifactId>
  <version>${org.apache.tiles-version}</version>
</dependency>

2. /WEB-INF/spring/appServlet/tiles-def.xml

xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE tiles-definitions PUBLIC
  "-//Apache Software Foundation//DTD Tiles Configuration 3.0//EN"
  "http://tiles.apache.org/dtds/tiles-config_3_0.dtd">

<tiles-definitions>
  <!-- 기본 틀 -->
  <definition name="layoutNo" template="/WEB-INF/views/layout/layoutNo.jsp" />

  <definition name="login/*" extends="layoutNo">
    <put-attribute name="header" value="/WEB-INF/views/login/{1}.jsp" />   <!-- {1} = * 값 -->
  </definition>

  <definition name="*/*" extends="layoutNo">
    <put-attribute name="header" value="/WEB-INF/views/include/header.jsp" />
    <put-attribute name="body"   value="/WEB-INF/views/{1}/{2}.jsp" />
    <put-attribute name="footer" value="/WEB-INF/views/include/footer.jsp" />
  </definition>
</tiles-definitions>

3. servlet-context.xml — ViewResolver 순서

xml
<!-- 기본 jsp 경로: order 2 -->
<beans:bean class="org.springframework.web.servlet.view.InternalResourceViewResolver">
  <beans:property name="prefix" value="/WEB-INF/views/" />
  <beans:property name="suffix" value=".jsp" />
  <beans:property name="order" value="2" />
</beans:bean>

<!-- Tiles: order 1 (먼저 찾음) -->
<beans:bean id="tilesViewResolver" class="org.springframework.web.servlet.view.UrlBasedViewResolver">
  <beans:property name="viewClass" value="org.springframework.web.servlet.view.tiles3.TilesView" />
  <beans:property name="order" value="1" />
</beans:bean>
<beans:bean id="tilesConfigurer" class="org.springframework.web.servlet.view.tiles3.TilesConfigurer">
  <beans:property name="definitions">
    <beans:list><beans:value>/WEB-INF/spring/appServlet/tiles-def.xml</beans:value></beans:list>
  </beans:property>
</beans:bean>

4. 레이아웃 jsp

jsp
<%@ taglib uri="http://tiles.apache.org/tags-tiles" prefix="tiles" %>
<body>
  <tiles:insertAttribute name="header" />
  <div class="container"><tiles:insertAttribute name="body" /></div>
  <tiles:insertAttribute name="footer" />
</body>
•Tiles 3.0.8 → viewClass 는 tiles3.TilesView (버전 2 는 tiles2)
•viewClass · order · definitions 는 클래스의 고정 필드 이름
•order 숫자가 작은 ViewResolver 를 먼저 사용

원본 메모의 xml 에서 template 따옴표 누락, UrlBasedViewResolver 를 <beans:beans> 로 쓴 부분을 <beans:bean> 으로 고쳤다.
